findings: Native986510 expands each AABB half-span by the supplied margin and projects all eight corners in XYZ nested order.
Projected XY use SSE CVTTSS2SI truncation, including invalid-to-INT_MIN conversion; min/max include every corner regardless of its success flag.
If every corner projection reports failure the output is[-1,-1,0,0]; otherwise only lower edges clamp to zero and upper edges to viewport width/height. No rectangle normalization occurs.
runtime_adapters: Original986510 instructions and constants execute;9854F0 supplies independent three-float screen points and success flags to isolate rectangle aggregation.
Viewport manager and caller stack supplied; no GPU or camera simulation.
limits: Actual9854F0 camera projection, actor AABB producer and semantic eligibility gates remain open.
Quarter-resolution rectangle scaling/merging, target initialization, draw and actual native mask pixels remain unqualified.
